title: Telemetry Journeys and Explainable Fallback Advisor for Canary/A-B/Shadow Rollouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Build a Console-first feature set that lets teams understand a request's lifecycle across a rollout experiment (canary/A-B/shadow), visually trace how traffic flowed, and get an explainable fallback recommendation when a variant violates SLOs. This ticket scopes a combined UI + telemetry contract: a Telemetry Journey view (timeline of request cohorts, per-route metric overlays, trace anchors) and an Explainable Fallback Advisor (rule- and model-driven suggestions for automatic rollback/fallback). Deliverables: telemetry contract, UI mockups, backend filter and join paths for traces and metrics, advisor decision heuristics and audit log entries.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry Journey view shows per-route latency, error rate, and token-cost overlays for at least two simultaneous variants (control + variant) over a selectable time window
Console links each plotted anomaly point to 1-3 traces and sample requests, grouped by top error types

Explainable Fallback Advisor surfaces the top 3 reasons for recommending a fallback (SLO breach, drift in semantic similarity, or traffic-weighted latency regression) with supporting metrics and recent traces
Advisor can be toggled to simulate recommendations (dry-run) and produces a machine-readable audit entry for any auto-rollback decision
The telemetry contract includes clear schema for per-route tags (route_id, variant_tag, cohort_id, trace_id, shard, sequence_len) and is documented in Confluence
Integration test demonstrates shadow traffic tagging and correct join of traces to aggregated per-route metrics in a synthetic canary scenario
design_notes: Avoid reusing 'cohort diff' language in UI; use 'Telemetry Journey' to emphasize temporal flow
Provide lightweight inline explainers (hover cards) that show how the Advisor computed each factor
Design must scale: support >20 variants in aggregate views via sampling and 'focus+context' summarization
Color palette should align variant colors with rollout editor to reduce cognitive load
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (alpha): backend telemetry schema + basic Journey UI for control vs single variant (console-2026.03-alpha)
Phase 2 (beta): Add trace linking, sample request playback, and Advisor dry-run mode; invite 3 internal customers
Phase 3 (GA): Enable Advisor auto-rollback with audit logging and canary policy editor integration; provide migration doc for existing customers
telemetry_schema: metric:route.latency.p50|p95|p99 - tagged by route_id, variant_tag, path_template
metric:route.token.cost - per-request token cost and aggregated unit cost
tag:trace_id - full trace link to internal tracing system
tag:cohort_id - generated for each rollout snapshot or AB bucket
tag:shadow_source - boolean string 'true'|'false' for shadow traffic
tracing_links: Rule: match trace_id tag on metric sample to link to tracing UI (minimum payload: trace_id, route_id, timestamp)
Fallback evidence policy: include 3 sample traces — most representative latency, highest error count, and median token cost
